Resources & Advice

Thought becomes practice, leaving creations that can keep growing.

PRACTICAL GUIDE

From an Idea to Something of Your Own

Begin with a subscription, global instructions, and search. Connect native-language reading, personal philosophy, Web/local work, Drive, and configuration, with ongoing collection, updates, and repair.

Documents & diagrams

Yinyang, Skills, philosophical documents, and diagrams grow through actual collaboration. GitHub preserves their source for inspection, revision, and further creation; these pages present their public reading edition.

Reusable Skills and their companions

These methods retain useful companion relationships. Read each package’s dependencies, download the needed companions, and configure your own environment. Package licenses remain MIT.

抽卡转盘 · random-wheel

Turn screenshot choices or named options into a speed-adjustable animated wheel with equal-probability random selection.
